summary: Tested the swap from the 183 Unesp courses replacing the SEDUC cargo list. Candidate flow PASSES. /dados-inscricao.html: select-vaga is labeled 'Curso' and has the placeholder 'Informe o Curso' plus exactly 183 options. The options match cursos.txt line for line and in the same order. Every option has data-price 225.00 and no 'Professor' option remains. Two runs: the long Música (Sopros) course at 1920 and Treineiro at 390. In both, the full course name is shown on confirmacao (c-vaga, 'Curso Escolhido'), inscricao-realizada (r-vaga, R$ 225,00), pagamento-pix (p-vaga, p-valor R$ 225,00, PIX code 5406225.00) and minhas-inscricoes ('Curso' row, R$ 225,00). The backend stores the full cargo_titulo with valor 225 and taxa 'R$ 225,00'. Mobile 390: scrollWidth is 390 on every page, even with the long name; the select is 300px wide and the long text wraps cleanly. ADMIN BUG: when one CPF has more than one inscription, the Inscrições list shows the wrong course. admin-extras.js matches rows by CPF+valor, and every fee is now 225, so each row of that CPF gets the first course in the list. The 'Exibir' modal's E-mail field is also replaced with a course name.

ui_bugs.issue: With 2 inscriptions for the same CPF (Música 141 + Treineiro 178), BOTH rows showed 'Treineiro'. The row finds its inscription by CPF + valor, and every fee is now 225, so it always takes inscs[0]. The API data is correct.

In the Identificação section the E-mail field shows a course name ('Treineiro') instead of the email. enrichInscriptionRows treats every leaf element with an email that sits near a CPF and 'R$' text as a list row, and the modal matches that. It also used the wrong course. In 'Outros dados' the label is still 'Cargo Titulo' (should be 'Curso').

issues: Neither page shows the taxa R$ 225,00. The value first appears on inscricao-realizada. Consider adding a 'Taxa' row on confirmacao or a note under the Curso select.

action_items: Fix admin-extras.js enrichInscriptionRows: pick the inscription by row order/created_at/protocolo + cargo instead of CPF+valor. Skip elements inside the details modal so the E-mail field is not overwritten.
Rename the 'Cargo Titulo' label in the admin details modal to 'Curso'.
Optional: show 'Taxa: R$ 225,00' on dados-inscricao or confirmacao.

Optional cleanup: inscricao-realizada.html fallback (when __taxa is missing) still uses the old 120/160 SEDUC logic and should fall back to 225. /index.html meta title/description still say 'Professor SEDUC 2026'.
critical_code_review_comments: admin-extras.js uses DOM text scraping (looks for '@' leaf + CPF + R$ in ancestors) to inject course names. This is fragile and caused the wrong-course/email-overwrite bug.
The protocolo comes only from the CPF ('2026'+last 6 digits), so two inscriptions from the same CPF get the same protocolo (seen: both 2026224725).
Course codes are now '1'..'183', while backend docs/comments mention '01103'/'COD' formats. They work, but the comments are stale.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (candidate flow 100%; admin list wrong course for multi-inscription CPF)

seed_data_creation: Test inscriptions for CPFs 52998224725 and 11144477735 were created and then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fast setup: seed localStorage inscricao_dados {NOME,CPF,EMAIL,DATA_NASCIMENTO,SEXO} on /dados-inscricao.html, reload, select course + municipio + termo, then click btn-cadastrar. Long course is index 141, Treineiro is 178. To reproduce the admin bug: finalize 2 different courses with the same CPF, then open /donaspainel > Inscrições.
